name: @gugacarbo/skill-code-flow
description: Development tooling for the code-flow skill.

scripts.build: bash -lc 'for file in scripts/*.sh scripts/visual-companion/*.sh; do bash -n "$file"; done; python3 -c "import ast, pathlib; ast.parse(pathlib.Path(\"scripts/source-set-digest.py\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))"; if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node --check scripts/visual-companion/server.cjs; fi'
